website:language_versions: The new site should let visitors switch between English and Spanish, with the same core pages available in both languages.
Please prepare a French version of the website alongside the English one so our Quebec customers can browse in their own language.
We serve clients in Arabic and English; the website needs both language experiences, including right-to-left presentation where appropriate.
website:booking_rules: Visitors should be able to reserve a consultation online, but the calendar must block staff holidays and prevent overlapping appointments.
We need a booking flow for thirty-minute discovery calls that offers only weekday slots and sends people a confirmation after they choose one.
Let customers request an installation date from our available windows; weekends and dates already assigned to another job should not appear.
brand:brand_guidelines: Along with the new identity, please hand over a practical guide showing logo clear space, approved colors, type choices, and examples of correct use.
Our team needs a brand manual they can give to future designers so every campaign follows the same visual rules.
Include a concise style guide for the refreshed brand, covering marks, color values, fonts, and what to avoid when applying them.
seo:business_locations: Local search should cover all three clinics in Brighton, Hove, and Lewes, with the correct address and service details for each.
We operate from two showrooms, one in Bristol and one in Bath; both locations need to be represented accurately in the SEO work.
Please make it easier for nearby customers to find our Manchester and Salford offices, treating each branch as its own local presence.
ads:retargeting_audience: We want follow-up ads for people who viewed the pricing page but did not ask for a quote, excluding anyone who already became a customer.
Please bring shoppers back after they leave items in their cart, while keeping purchasers out of that audience.
The campaign should re-engage previous site visitors who explored our service pages without booking, rather than showing the same ads to everyone.
analytics:tracking_events: We need to see distinct conversion events for brochure downloads, demo requests, and completed contact forms in the analytics setup.
Please measure when a visitor starts checkout, finishes a purchase, or abandons the payment step so we can see where orders drop off.
Track the key actions on the new site, especially appointment bookings and newsletter signups, as named events in our reporting.
email:email_segments: Our mailing list should be split into new leads, active customers, and people who have not bought in a year so each group gets relevant messages.
Please set up separate email audiences for wholesale buyers and direct-to-consumer shoppers instead of sending the same campaign to both.
The welcome sequence needs to distinguish first-time subscribers from existing clients and tailor the copy to each group.
ecommerce:catalog_details: The shop must hold each product's SKU, size and color options, photographs, price, and stock count, including separate variants for each size.
Please import the catalog with accurate descriptions, dimensions, shipping weights, and images so customers can compare the items properly.
Our inventory includes configurable products; the store needs variant-level codes, availability, and pricing rather than one generic entry per product.
